prompts.locomotion:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent pixel art sprite animation atlas for an original retro first-person game, replacing a blocky 3D protagonist. Input image: identity and painting reference only. Use the HEALTHY male hero in the TOP LEFT tile of the reference: expressive thick dark eyebrows, tousled brown hair with loose forelock, short brown beard, warm light tan skin, olive khaki open hoodie with cream drawstrings over a rust-orange shirt. Draw his WHOLE BODY as a handsome expressive hand-painted 1990s shooter sprite. Dark grey-green cargo pants and tan leather work boots. Normal adult proportions, strong readable silhouette, natural rounded cloth shapes, strong accurate face from reference; NOT a low-poly 3D render, NOT chibi, NOT a generic soldier. Calm, alert expression. No injuries, no weapon, no logos. Flat consistent sprite lighting, warm skin and matte olive clothing, crisp pixel-art edges and painted shading matching the supplied portrait.
Composition: exactly 8 columns by 4 rows on a square 2048x2048 TRANSPARENT canvas, 32 separate full-body sprites. Every cell is 256x512. All characters entirely inside their own cell, heads aligned at same height, soles on a shared baseline near the bottom of each cell, equal body height in all cells, generous clear padding, no ground shadows or background. Columns always show the same eight azimuths: column 1 front facing viewer; column 2 front three-quarter facing LEFT of image; column 3 left-facing profile; column 4 rear three-quarter facing left; column 5 straight back; column 6 rear three-quarter facing right; column 7 right-facing profile; column 8 front three-quarter facing right. Eye-level orthographic views, no overhead perspective.
Row 1: idle, both feet planted, hands loosely down by hips. Row 2: WALK stride with left leg forward and right arm forward. Row 3: WALK passing pose, feet nearly aligned, one heel lifted. Row 4: WALK opposite stride with right leg forward and left arm forward. Small coherent movements, identical head/body size, clothing and identity across all 32 cells. No text, no labels, no grid lines, no border, no scene, no checkerboard painted into the image. Actual transparent alpha background. Keep the reference hero's face and costume identity aggressively.

Exactly 8 columns x 4 rows, 32 full-body sprites in an evenly spaced square canvas matching the supplied atlases. Each sprite entirely fits its own cell, including feet and extended equipment. Same eye-level view, same physical scale and head height; do NOT enlarge or shrink character between poses.
